name: sekhmet
description: Sekhmet — always-available Codex Titanium swarm substrate (xbreed L3, max 64 runners).

interface.shortDescription: Always-on swarm dispatch substrate — layer 3 of xbreed
interface.longDescription: Sekhmet is always available to be called: pure L3 worker surface under xbreed/xbgst for swarm dispatch. Namespaced ephemeral codex-spark runs without git worktrees, double-work tolerant, with dry-run, --ro, --scope, --timeout, collect, and gc. Rust-only binary xbrd-spark (source VeigaPunk/xbrd-spark).
defaultPrompt: Run a live Sekhmet spark with --direct and collect results.
Explain Sekhmet as layer 3 of xbreed.
